summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, announcing the timing of its Q1 2026 results publication and an investor presentation on May 11, 2026. The press release includes standard logistics for a quarterly earnings call and contact details for analysts and investors. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, tender offers, or management changes. This filing is a routine notification of upcoming financial results and investor communication.
